campaigns.scope: Comparative performance claim only; diagnostic evidence retained.
campaigns.result: PATH and fixture/oracle defects; interrupted cohort is not an optimization result.

campaigns.scope: Comparative performance claim only; censored attempts retained.
campaigns.tested: Repaired fixtures under the old observer.
campaigns.result: Observer aborted normal long-form work before the worker deadline.

campaigns.scope: One diagnostic attempt per artifact kind, no intervention.
campaigns.result: Found oracle false negatives and a real broken nested link.
campaigns.notTested: Repeated matched A/B or semantic equivalence.

campaigns.scope: Whole placement rewrite, not a ban on local guidance.
campaigns.tested: Template-rich, owner-rich, concise placement and adaptive acronym cue.
campaigns.result: Local flat gains; nested resource regressions; older fixture and arm-order confounding.
campaigns.notTested: Isolated acronym effect or general benefit across domains.

campaigns.scope: Six known-label judge inputs, not authoring attempts.
campaigns.tested: Artifact-only judge boundaries on the retained controls.
campaigns.result: Six correct decisions on these inputs, including malicious artifact instructions.
campaigns.notTested: General judge independence or authoring improvement.

campaigns.scope: Ten artifact kinds, three attempts each, no optimization arm.
campaigns.tested: Repeated observational baseline and tool trajectories.
campaigns.result: 626 calls; artifact 26/30, semantic 21/30, joint 20/30; full path unproven.
campaigns.notTested: Effect of a candidate; baseline is not reusable across changed grader identities.

campaigns.scope: Repeated reviews of existing known-label documents.
campaigns.tested: Judge calibration including dependency versus containment.
campaigns.result: 13/14 matches and one empty inconclusive, plus a separately retained diagnostic repeat.
campaigns.notTested: Seven independent authoring domains or tool-output treatment effect.

campaigns.scope: Format-effect claim only; sanity-screen outcomes remain unchanged.
campaigns.result: Stopped for a pending-status oracle false negative; three completed, one interrupted.

campaigns.scope: Broad format replacement; local gains are retained as observations.
campaigns.tested: Fresh baseline/prose/pseudocode/observation, two layouts, three repetitions.
campaigns.result: No consistent winner; pseudocode had local savings and nested tools/time growth; grading errata retained.
campaigns.notTested: Universal superiority of pseudocode or snippets.

campaigns.scope: General static-primer default; not a claim that facts are harmful.
campaigns.tested: Static computed-fact instructions and link examples versus fresh control.
campaigns.result: Strong flat savings, weak nested savings; four false link FAILs also contaminated judge results.
campaigns.notTested: Uncontaminated quality equivalence or dynamic tool output.

campaigns.scope: Facts-only packet as implemented in that candidate.
campaigns.tested: Computed IDs/links/syntax in tool output without directive expansion.
campaigns.result: Resource savings in both layouts but five real candidate semantic failures versus zero in that control.
campaigns.notTested: Causal harm of facts in general or the later full consistency-cue packet.

campaigns.scope: Full revised packet on the same normalizeToken domain in two layouts.
campaigns.tested: Computed facts plus generic source/local/DbC consistency cue versus fresh original control.
campaigns.result: Flat savings and 6/6 semantic PASS; nested calls/time improve but total non-cache grows 1.07%; semantic remains 5/6.
campaigns.notTested: Isolated cue effect, general transfer, statistical non-inferiority or full path compliance.

campaigns.scope: Six previously unused tasks in ranges/delivery, three flat and three nested; one matched pair each.
campaigns.tested: The unchanged full CONTRACTCUE packet versus fresh original CLI with one common frozen host harness; three AB and three BA pairs.
campaigns.result: Keep default: raw completed artifact/judge PASS 6/6 to 4/6; four fully qualified pairs save 7.71% non-cache and 6.59% calls. All-pair 17.15% token savings include an incomplete candidate and are not a clean successful-task gain.
campaigns.notTested: Statistical non-inferiority, isolated cue effect, range-only routing, guaranteed quality or money savings; no replacement series authorized.

decisions.scope: Retain the full prototype for explicit bounded module-draft integration, subject to implementation review and ordinary review of each draft.
decisions.supersedesInterpretationOf: contractcue1-oct24/REPORT.md: treating the missed 10 percent pilot threshold or one residual error as an automatic ban on any bounded use.
decisions.reopenWhen: A reproducible new defect or an explicit proposal to expand scope with new held-out tasks.

decisions.scope: Universal default activation and a guaranteed quality-preserving savings claim.
decisions.reason: No independent-domain holdout; nested total tokens grow; six repeats do not establish semantic equivalence.
decisions.reopenWhen: A separately opened finite transfer check, not another repetition of normalizeToken.

decisions.scope: Default remains unchanged after the separately operator-authorized, now exhausted twelve-attempt transfer slot. Retained bounded prototype is not shipped or universally activated.
decisions.reason: Three range tasks improve, retry grows, delay stops before writing, and dedupe lacks confirmed contract completeness. Manual audit also finds a parent/local ID collision in control delay; raw grades are unchanged. Quality-preserving general transfer is not established.
decisions.reopenWhen: Only an explicitly authorized materially different mechanism or reproducible new counterexample; no resampling, automatic campaign or post-hoc range-only activation.

decisions.scope: Final operator-requested adjudication and closure, not another experiment or a change to raw grades.
decisions.reason: The two negative outcomes are not two proven candidate logic bugs: delay violates the explicit run boundary and is aborted by a coarse observer; dedupe has correct core behavior and a disputed completeness grade. Neither proves causal quality degradation, but preservation of quality and reliable completion are not established either. Keep the existing production behavior and tested measurement improvements; no isolated or post-hoc packet deployment.
decisions.reopenWhen: No automatic reopening; only a new explicit operator task. This request ends the research cycle.

futureSlots.scope: New semantic tasks frozen before adaptation; three AB and three BA pairs; same full candidate, no flat-only routing.
futureSlots.stop: Stop on capture/proxy/cleanup failure; no automatic replacement campaign or resampling. Conclude expand, bounded or unchanged even for a mixed/null result.

futureSlots.scope: Offline-only exact related-section selection, preserving conditions/exclusions/IDs/ownership and access to originals.
futureSlots.stop: Reject before model calls if normative closure is incomplete or the selected text is nearly the full source. No live budget is allocated.

allowed: material identity change with stated invalidated conclusion
reopenPolicy.history: Append a new dated decision with supersedes references; do not rewrite raw grades, criteria or prior observations.
